name: AILoadingIndicators
description: Three distinct loading patterns for AI response stages. AIWorkingIndicator shows animated pulsing dots during generation. AIThinkingIndicator shows collapsible reasoning steps with done/active/pending
intent: A family of loading states that communicate AI thinking, processing, and progress. Different variants map to different task lengths and complexity levels.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: theme
props.hint: Surface tint: default (brand), tan (dark tan border), gray, white.

props.name: steps
props.hint: Array of reasoning steps for AIThinkingIndicator.

props.name: collapsed
props.hint: Controls whether thinking steps are collapsed.

notes: Use indicators sequentially — never show all three at once.
theme='tan' or AIGettingInfoIndicatorTan for companion surfaces.

forbiddenUsage: Do not show all three indicators at the same time — use them sequentially
Do not keep any indicator visible after the response has fully rendered
